# LeadPilot AI CRM — Subscription Lifecycle

**Module:** Subscription Lifecycle  
**Version:** v2.2.0  

---

## 1. Lifecycle States

```
[ Trialing ] ---> [ Active ] ---> [ Past Due ] ---> [ Canceled ]
```

1. **Trialing:** 14-day free trial on Professional plan.
2. **Active:** Regular monthly or annual subscription.
3. **Past Due:** 3-day grace period on payment failure.
4. **Canceled:** Downgraded to free read-only access.
